title: Chapter 835
text:
The interface indicated that [Bold Explorer] had taken effect, and Han Xiao's vision entered another illusion. He already knew how the skill worked, so he calmed down and looked at the information.

Two figures appeared in the illusion, surrounded by chaotic blue-black space energy. It was as if they were in a wormhole.

The two figures were very familiar. One was his past self, and the other was EsGod's doppelganger. This scene made Han Xiaoxin's heart skip a beat.

This set of wormhole data came from the wormhole that EsGod's doppelganger had passed through. This was the process at that time.

The image changed, and his past self escaped from the wormhole according to the original development. However, Han Xiao's vision was locked onto EsGod's doppelganger, watching as EsGod's doppelganger floated in the space turbulence.

"It's here, it's here." Seeing this, Han Xiao was energized.

He did not know what happened after he exiled EsGod's doppelganger. It seemed like he could finally know what happened to EsGod's doppelganger on the other side of the wormhole that caused EsGod to be so obsessed with the coordinates of this wormhole.

The next moment, EsGod's doppelganger finally passed through the wormhole and was spat out, appearing in a pitch-black universe.

EsGod's doppelganger in the image could not wait for Han Xiao and realized that he had been tricked. He seemed a little annoyed and stayed on the spot for a while before suddenly teleporting in a certain direction. Han Xiao's vision followed EsGod's doppelganger.

Not long later, EsGod's doppelganger suddenly stopped, and a strange planet appeared in front of him. There were many wormholes outside the planet's atmosphere, and plant roots extended out from the void and connected to the planet's surface. Beams of energy were absorbed by the roots as if they were absorbing the planet's nutrients.

"This is …" Han Xiao's pupils constricted, and he was shocked.

He did not expect to see this thing here!

Before he could think, the situation in the image suddenly changed!

A dark space crack appeared beside EsGod's doppelganger, and more than ten thin plant roots suddenly shot out like vines and wrapped around EsGod's doppelganger tightly.

At this time, the illusion disappeared, and the image stopped there. Han Xiao's vision returned to reality.

"F * ck, why is it cut off here?"

Han Xiao almost cursed out loud. He was just waiting to see what would happen to the EsGod doppelganger, and it ended just like that?

How infuriating!

Taking a deep breath, Han Xiao recalled the fragments of information he had just received. His expression was uncertain.

If this piece of information was shown to others, it would only make them feel that it was meaningless and worthless. In the entire explored universe, other than himself, there was probably no one else who knew what this piece of information meant.

He might be the only one who knew what those roots were. It was the Universal Civilization that invaded in the later versions of his previous life — the World Tree Civilization!

"The World Tree Civilization is several versions away from now, and it actually appeared at this stage?" Han Xiao subconsciously bit his nails with a solemn expression.

He finally understood that this set of wormhole data was connected to the territory of the World Tree Civilization. EsGod's doppelganger had coincidentally transmigrated to that area!

The World Tree Civilization was located in the unexplored universe and was very far away from the explored universe. The three Universal Civilizations and the World Tree did not know of each other's existence. To a powerful civilization, exploring the unknown was a necessary mission. It was only a matter of time before they met. However, in the later versions of his previous life, the World Tree Civilization discovered the existence of the three Universal Civilizations and finally decided to launch an invasion. A super large-scale universal war broke out that no one could avoid.

At this stage, there should not be any interaction between the two sides!

"If not for me, the Dark-star leader would not have brought EsGod's doppelganger to attack me, and EsGod would not have met the World Tree Civilization. Sh * t, this is probably the biggest butterfly effect I've caused so far …"

Han Xiao's expression was grave.

The fragment of information earlier contained a lot of information.

He knew that the World Tree Civilization was a special civilization. The World Tree was equivalent to their Universal Treasure, and it was of the highest grade. It was worshipped and nourished by the entire civilization, and at the same time, it brought unparalleled benefits to the entire civilization. It was a companion to the civilization.

The World Tree was rooted in the dimension and had a keen sense of energy. The EsGod doppelganger was discovered by the roots of the World Tree. Although he did not know what happened to the EsGod doppelganger, it was clear that EsGod had not forgotten about this set of wormhole data. The two had already made contact!

"EsGod is probably researching this set of data to find the exact location of the World Tree Civilization. He said that this is the hope for the next step of evolution … Could it be that this bastard was bewitched by the World Tree Civilization and wants to lead the way?"

Thinking of this, Han Xiao's expression changed.

If the World Tree Civilization discovered the location of the three Universal Civilizations in advance because of the EsGod doppelganger's visit, the invasion of the World Tree Civilization would very likely break out in advance. That would be a disaster for the entire explored universe!

If the World Tree Civilization's war broke out in advance, the storyline he was familiar with would be completely overturned, and his advantage of foresight would be greatly reduced. At the same time, he would lose the time to accumulate his strength.

Although he already had the strength of a Beyond Grade A, in such a large-scale galactic war that was comparable to the exploration era, even a Beyond Grade A Super could not guarantee that he would survive.

After all, far too many Beyond Grade A Supers had died in this war in his previous life.

"Thankfully, that's only an EsGod doppelganger. With EsGod's personality, he might not reveal everything to outsiders …"

EsGod wanted to find the location of the World Tree Civilization and not wait for the World Tree Civilization to arrive. This meant that EsGod might not have revealed any information about the explored universe.

At this point, Han Xiao could only pray that EsGod did not tell the World Tree Civilization about the existence of the three Universal Civilizations.

However, if EsGod was allowed to continue researching this set of data, he would definitely obtain results one day and drag everyone into the flames of war. No one would be able to stay out of it.

This was a ticking time bomb that could not be ignored!

"I can't let him continue researching …" Han Xiao clenched his teeth.

So far, he had only fought EsGod twice. Although they were enemies, he knew that he would not be able to do anything to EsGod in the short term.

However, today, Han Xiao felt an urge to kill EsGod for the first time. He could not wait to get rid of EsGod!

"EsGod is able to survive in the cracks of the three Universal Civilizations. Even if I ask the dynasty for help, it will most likely be useless. Furthermore, I don't have any evidence to prove the existence of the World Tree Civilization, so the dynasty won't be determined to get rid of EsGod …"

[Bold Explorer] could only be used on himself and could not be shared with others. Even if he told the dynasty, the dynasty would not believe the existence of the World Tree Civilization. The only way to make the dynasty believe him was to interrogate EsGod.

However, if he wanted to interrogate EsGod, he would have to capture EsGod first. Otherwise, EsGod would not reveal anything.

"EsGod purposely told me about the abnormalities in the set of data because he wants to use me to indirectly borrow the dynasty's technology to complete his research. No matter who finds the location of the World Tree Civilization first, it's a good thing for him … However, since he's using me, EsGod obviously won't reveal what he saw."

Han Xiao frowned. He realized that there were not many external forces that he could rely on in this matter.

Unless … the dynasty also had some results on this set of data and did not discover the existence of the World Tree Civilization at the same time. Then, in order to keep the existence of the entire explored universe a secret, the dynasty would have a strong need to get rid of EsGod.

"Difficult, the conditions are too harsh. Although the dynasty has the experience of the exploration era war and knows how to hide from unfamiliar existences, with the existence of Order, the dynasty might take the initiative to contact the other party." Han Xiao shook his head helplessly. If he had known that this set of wormhole data led to the World Tree Civilization, he would not have handed it to the dynasty for research. There were simply too many uncontrollable factors. The moment something went wrong, the universe war that would only appear in the later versions might erupt prematurely.

Now, only I know about this. It's too difficult to deal with this matter by myself … Han Xiaoxin felt heavy.

"Dealing with EsGod has to be put on the agenda. My current strength is not enough to fight EsGod alone … Sigh, the experience penalty period is so long …"

Han Xiao had a helpless expression.

…

After staying on Planet Lighthouse for more than half a month, a few new exploration teams finally arrived at the Flickering World.

Tarrokov received the leaders of these exploration teams at the base, and Han Xiao ran over to join in the fun. He wanted to meet the members of the second batch of exploration teams and make some new friends.

In the conference room, everyone walked in and saw Tarrokov waiting there. They then turned to look at Han Xiao.

"Hello, Chief Commander Tarrokov. Hello, Your Excellency Black Star."

None of the Star Cluster Civilization commanders were unfamiliar with this new ally of the dynasty who had the Evolution Cube. They all looked at him curiously. Han Xiao nodded with a smile.

"Haha, we meet again." Beyoni laughed and greeted. "I heard that the Arcane Church wants to attack you. It seems like you need my help."

Before he finished his sentence, someone beside him suddenly said, "It's' our 'help."

Han Xiao turned around to size this person up. He saw that this person was a glowing energy body. A blazing red light flowed all over his body. His structure was that of a humanoid creature. There was no mouth or nose on his face, only a pair of bright golden dragon eyes.

"You are …" Han Xiao was stunned and did not recognize him.

"Milizaus," the energy entity said calmly. "Don't be surprised. This is just a magical energy avatar. My main body did not descend."

Han Xiao shook hands with the magical energy avatar and said, "It's an honor to meet you, the king of the Dragonblood Nation and the leader of the Astral Spiritual Dragon Race."

At the same time, he secretly entered the quantum network and looked at the outer space of Planet Lighthouse through the surveillance camera.

A dragon the size of a main ship was soaring in the outer space of the planet. The dragon had a long beard, and its body was covered in diamond-shaped dragon scales. Even the smallest scale was a few meters long. The dragon's body was silver, purple, and green, and there seemed to be starlight flowing through the gaps between the scales. Although its body was huge, it gave off a streamlined and agile feeling.

This was an Astral Spiritual Dragon. Even among the same race, its size was extremely shocking. This was the main body of Milizaus. He was a non-humanoid intelligent creature.

The Astral Spiritual Dragon Race was a Beyond Grade A inherited race. It was a bloodline branch left behind by a Magic Blue Dragon that had broken through the limit and reached Beyond Grade A in the past. They were born with powerful magic talents. Although their reproduction rate was not high, an adult Astral Spiritual Dragon could reach Grade B at the very least.

Milizaus was the second Beyond Grade A of this inherited race. He was a unique dragon Mage who had the characteristics of both a normal Mage and a Magic Circuit Mage. He could learn all kinds of spells, but when using the inherited spells of the dragon race, the power would be greatly increased. Currently, Milizaus was the leader of the entire inherited race. His status was similar to that of the Mecha Empire's Manison, who was the leader of the Mechanical Race.

Furthermore, due to the strength of the dragon race, Milizaus was also a member of the Ancient Ones Club. Other than Ravenlaude, he was the other Ancient One of the allies of the Red Empire.

However, the Ancient Ones were a loose alliance. His position was different from Ravenlaude's. To some extent, they did not have a good relationship. Ravenlaude was also a Mage, and the two of them had different philosophies on magic.

Obviously, Milizaus had become a new species and was no longer a pure Astral Spiritual Dragon. Due to his huge body, he usually used his magic avatar to communicate with others.

"I've heard a lot about you, the Immortal Black Star." Milizaus' voice was hoarse, but his personality was very cheerful and not as cold as Clottey. This was mainly because they were all Beyond Grade As and could only communicate with each other on the same level.

"With me here, you don't have to worry about the Arcane Church. Maybe they won't dare do anything when they see me here."

"Haha, then I'll have to prepare the Evolution Cube for you in advance." Han Xiao laughed. Suddenly, his eyes turned. "By the way, are you interested in making another deal with me? It's still about the Evolution Cube."

"Oh?" Milizaus' interest was piqued. "You know me very well. Alright, let's have a good talk after the meeting."

Ravenlaude, who was at the side, glanced at Han Xiao with a playful expression. He nodded at Han Xiao as a greeting and sat down with the rest without saying anything else.

Because of Aesop, Ravenlaude did not want to get close to Black Star. As a Mage, he was not very interested in the Evolution Cube. Furthermore, both of them were exploring the Garu Star Cluster and had a competitive relationship. Ravenlaude did not intend to let their nodding relationship develop further. He was not someone who liked to get close to others.
